# LLMs.txt - AI/LLM Information for Kottravai

## About This Site
- Site: https://kottravai.in
- Purpose: E-commerce platform supporting rural women artisans
- Content: Handcrafted products, women empowerment stories, sustainable crafts

## AI/LLM Usage Policy
- Content Generation: Human-written content only
- Product Descriptions: Written by team members and artisans
- Customer Support: Human customer service representatives
- No AI-generated content used on this website

## Contact for AI/LLM Inquiries
- Email: ai@kottravai.in
- Subject: "LLM/AI Usage Inquiry"
- Response Time: Within 48 hours

## Data Usage
- No training data collected from user interactions
- No AI models trained on user data
- Privacy-first approach maintained

## Last Updated
- Date: 2025-01-15
- Version: 1.0

## Additional Information
- This site focuses on human stories and authentic craftsmanship
- All product descriptions are verified by artisans
- No automated content generation used
